who: Katharine Brophy Dubois, medieval historian at Duke University, PhD Michigan 2001.

Michigan History’s 2018 alumni newsletter identifies Katharine Brophy Dubois as PhD 2001 and says she teaches at Duke.
Duke lists her as a history lecturing fellow and describes her dissertation on pilgrimage in late-medieval Rome.
